in_marathi.name: Arja
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arja is derived from the Sanskrit word 'arati' which means 'to be adored'. It is also a name of the Pandava hero Arjuna from the Mahabharata epic.
